page.overview:
Who is Windchill?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Windchill was available in the 1989 series of A Real American Hero toys, packaged with the Arctic Blast vehicle. ---- Appearance: white cap with black goggles; yellow hair and mustache; white jacket with black camouflage and gloves; grey pants; black boots

Accessories: black machine gun with long scope, curved stock, and angled grip and magazine; two black skis armed with lasers. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/89/windchill.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/89/windchill.shtml Filecard]
